Private memory was a locator only; contracts checked against current source and retained documents.
Historical acceptance evidence is dated; actual client configuration/rollout remains separate.

review_supplement.source: User-supplied ChatGPT review conveying reported client-visit observation and adoption clarifications
review_supplement.principle: Guided accounting forms; familiar financial review tables; validated editable grids only for legitimate drafts/configuration
review_supplement.later_client_adoption: Dedicated readiness/adoption pass after final source review and separately authorized safe working rollout/configuration
review_supplement.external_systems: No cloning, integration, imported accounting policies, verified transfer formats or compatibility claims
review_supplement.year_default: January-December initially; date/month-based arithmetic without historical rewrite
review_supplement.authorization: Bounded documentation clarification; no broad planning cycle, full approval verdict or implementation command inferred
